scope: Follow-up defined after the five-seed probe found no further one-number improving exchanges. Uses no lottery history; exact fair-draw coverage, not predictive accuracy.
objective: Exact count of main-number outcomes giving at least three matches on one or more of the same ten rows
acceptance: Always accept nonnegative changes; otherwise use exp(change/temperature). Keep and return the best exact portfolio visited.
verification: Verify each returned portfolio against the independent reference evaluator; preserve the previous results and report all five runs.
interpretation: More computation at the same ticket budget, not an equal-runtime optimizer comparison or global-optimum claim
